advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Consider adding a post-tickets-mount pack-size guard to standalone verify-identity.yml (as the Gerrit lane has) so a server that ignores the inherited filter is caught.
evidence: verify-identity.yml:40 guard step 'Fail closed if the blobless checkout pack exceeds its limit' precedes the mount
verify-identity.yml:71 `git fetch origin '+tickets:refs/remotes/origin/tickets'` — no explicit --filter; relies on named-remote inheritance
gerrit-verify.yaml:270 the Gerrit guard runs AFTER the fetch+worktree materialization, catching tickets bloat
ticket 037b: 'Config presence is insufficient because Git records partialclonefilter even when a server ignores it'
advisory.finding: The standalone verify-identity.yml pack-size guard runs immediately after actions/checkout, BEFORE the 'Mount tickets branch' step's plain `git fetch origin +tickets`; that tickets fetch depends on inherited `remote.origin.partialclonefilter`, and if the server ignores the inherited filter the oversized tickets pack is pulled with no size guard covering it (the Gerrit lane, by contrast, guards after materialization).
scenarios: A GitHub server that silently ignores the inherited partial-clone filter on the standalone tickets fetch would restore the ~1GiB regression with no guard tripping

ABSENCE: `search_files gc.auto` over .github/workflows returned no matches — no job disables auto-gc, so `rebar verify-identity` walking objects may trigger a repack that mutates the loose/packed layout independent of any promisor fetch
dropped.finding: The identity object-DB snapshot guard compares the entire `git count-objects -v` output with `cmp -s`; no workflow sets `gc.auto=0`, so a benign `git gc --auto` repack (loose→packed) triggered during `rebar verify-identity` changes `count`/`in-pack`/`packs`/`size` lines and trips the guard, causing a spurious fail-closed CI failure even when no promisor object was fetched.
scenarios: A verify-identity run that crosses git's gc.auto loose-object threshold repacks mid-step and the after-snapshot differs from before
